claim: Probes with small supervisor models give calibrated line-level estimates of which lines a minimal repair will edit; BSS about 0.2, versus negative BSS for token probability and verbalized line ratings before scaling.
stance_target: probe beats verbal and sampled readouts at line level on code; L4 localization occupied
scope_conditions: GPT-4o and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct as models under test
quoted_support: Table 4 (Qwen): Line Verbalized BSS -0.72 ECE 0.43 AUC 0.71; Probe-7B BSS 0.29 ECE 0.08 AUC 0.83.
numbers: Table 3 GPT-4o: Line Verbalized BSS -0.18 ECE 0.26 AUC 0.75; Probe-7B BSS 0.16 ECE 0.10 AUC 0.78; Probe-0.5B BSS 0.17 ECE 0.05 AUC 0.76
Table 4 Qwen: Token Prob BSS -1.18 ECE 0.54 AUC 0.55; Multisampling BSS 0.01 ECE 0.17 AUC 0.72; Probe-0.5B BSS 0.30 ECE 0.05 AUC 0.82
